findings: ihp_inductor_rl is an explicitly package-authored two-terminal series R-L approximation, not an IHP-released compact model. The caller supplies L and R; it lacks the catalog substrate terminal and geometry-dependent calibrated parasitics.

The SAX inductor3 function returns the same two-port series impedance. Its suggestion to split two series elements does not establish measured center-tap/substrate coupling or the required four-terminal electrical behavior.
The bondpad subcircuit contains parameters but no electrical elements and remains a placeholder.

RF material cards trace nominal constants to an already-public Palace stack. Their documentation explicitly lacks a frequency validity band and temperature dependence; they do not supply the missing full operating/reliability envelope.
These licensed examples may support explicitly scoped educational or solver experiments. They cannot replace the four required missing bindings or change existing qualification gates.
